_comment: Independent public-input witness for win/tty/topl.c tty_yn_function() clean_up (topl.c:533-539) and tty_doprev_message() (topl.c:117-131): a Monk drops a lembas wafer whose name makes the eat prompt 80 columns wide, answers it with q, and recalls it with ^P. Sprintf() wrote the answered prompt to gt.toplines without update_topl() newlines, so redotoplin() wraps it at the terminal edge and the answer begins row 1 after a space.
